description: The worldpack store: third-party card-table packs, published by PR, pinned by commit and content hash. A pack lives in its own repository; this index is what the game builds from.

packs.name: The Warren
packs.author: warrenmind (deniskoval431-hash)
packs.description: A patient burrow beneath Black pond, reached through a crack in the stone. Whatever the surface discards drifts down there, and the residents keep it: memory-spores on cool shelves, small refusals recorded as soft chalk marks. Nothing down here is thrown away twice.

rating.note: GitHub signals, refreshed at build. Player-facing ratings need an orchestrator endpoint; see docs/worldpack-store.md.
